description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order amend the rate of CESS for Artical of Cement, with effect from 17th June, 2023
categorisation: This gazette notification amends the rate of CESS (a tax) on cement imports under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979. It constitutes a regulatory change to existing legislation through a statutory instrument, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would qualify it for Types 1-3.
